source.query:
SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day, type AS signal, count() AS interactions
FROM heatmaps
WHERE current_url = 'https://pitch-crew.tomer-norman.dev/'
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND type IN ('click', 'rageclick', 'deadclick')
GROUP BY day, signal
ORDER BY day, signal

SELECT round((y + viewport_height) * scale_factor / 500) * 500 AS reach_px_bucket, count() AS observations
FROM heatmaps
WHERE current_url = 'https://pitch-crew.tomer-norman.dev/'
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND type = 'scrolldepth'
GROUP BY reach_px_bucket
ORDER BY reach_px_bucket

SELECT round(x / nullIf(viewport_width, 0), 2) AS relative_x, y * scale_factor AS page_y_px, pointer_target_fixed AS fixed, count() AS clicks
FROM heatmaps
WHERE current_url = 'https://pitch-crew.tomer-norman.dev/'
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND type = 'click'
  AND viewport_width * scale_factor >= 768
GROUP BY relative_x, page_y_px, fixed
ORDER BY clicks DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT round(x / nullIf(viewport_width, 0), 2) AS relative_x, y * scale_factor AS page_y_px, pointer_target_fixed AS fixed, count() AS clicks
FROM heatmaps
WHERE current_url = 'https://pitch-crew.tomer-norman.dev/'
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND type = 'click'
  AND viewport_width * scale_factor < 768
GROUP BY relative_x, page_y_px, fixed
ORDER BY clicks DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT type AS signal, round(x / nullIf(viewport_width, 0), 2) AS relative_x, y * scale_factor AS page_y_px, count() AS observations
FROM heatmaps
WHERE current_url = 'https://pitch-crew.tomer-norman.dev/'
  AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY
  AND type IN ('rageclick', 'deadclick')
GROUP BY signal, relative_x, page_y_px
ORDER BY observations DESC
LIMIT 20
